azkar.textAr: أصبحت وأصبح الملك لله رب العالمين
azkar.textEn: I have become at dawn and the sovereignty belongs to Allah, the Lord of the worlds

azkar.textAr: اللهم ما أصبح بي من نعمة أو بأحد من خلقك فمنك وحدك لا شريك لك، فلك الحمد ولك الشكر
azkar.textEn: O Allah, whatever blessing has come to me or any of Your creation, it is from You alone with no partner, so for You is all praise and thanks
Glory be to Allah and with His praise

azkar.textAr: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، له الملك وله الحمد، وهو على كل شيء قدير
azkar.textEn: There is no deity except Allah alone, without partner, for Him is sovereignty and for Him is praise, and He is over all things competent

azkar.textAr: أمسيت وأمسى الملك لله رب العالمين
azkar.textEn: I have become in the evening and the sovereignty belongs to Allah, the Lord of the worlds

azkar.textAr: اللهم ما أمسى بي من نعمة أو بأحد من خلقك فمنك وحدك لا شريك لك، فلك الحمد ولك الشكر
azkar.textEn: O Allah, whatever blessing has come to me in the evening or any of Your creation, it is from You alone with no partner, so for You is all praise and thanks
Glory be to Allah and with His praise
Alhamdulillah (All praise is due to Allah)
La ilaha illallah (There is no deity except Allah)
